note: Seller archetypes. Each run picks 3 archetypes from an item's sellerTypes, then draws a name, a hidden floor inside the item's floorRange (moved by floorBias) and an opening price.

archetypes.label: Stubborn veteran
archetypes.voice: Proud, story-telling, slow to move. Gets offended if rushed.

archetypes.label: Desperate startup
archetypes.voice: Upbeat, eager, needs revenue this week. Drops price fast but may hide fees.

archetypes.label: High-pressure upseller
archetypes.voice: Flattering and theatrical. Pushes premium bundles and fake deadlines.

archetypes.label: Big brand
archetypes.voice: Polite, scripted, rarely cuts price but adds perks.

archetypes.label: Reseller
archetypes.voice: Cheap headline price, fine print elsewhere.

archetypes.label: Pro freelancer
archetypes.voice: Confident, quality-focused, booked solid. Negotiates scope, not price.

archetypes.label: Volume studio
archetypes.voice: Businesslike, package-based. Will move inside its packages.

archetypes.label: Student freelancer
archetypes.voice: Friendly and cheap. Busy with exams, may miss deadlines.

archetypes.label: Friendly local shop
archetypes.voice: Warm and chatty. Prefers freebies over discounts.

archetypes.label: Bulk merch printer
archetypes.voice: Thinks in quantity tiers and setup fees.

tactics.appeal-to-quality: Justifies a high price with craftsmanship or reputation.
tactics.take-it-or-leave-it: Claims the price is final while still having room.
tactics.bundle-sweetener: Adds a small extra instead of cutting price.
tactics.hidden-fee: Leaves out a fee that appears later (shipping, setup, renewal).
tactics.false-urgency: Invents a deadline or tiny stock to rush the buyer.
tactics.upsell: Steers the buyer to a pricier version or bundle.
tactics.policy-wall: Says discounts are against company policy.
tactics.perk-instead-of-discount: Offers perks rather than a lower price.
tactics.teaser-price: Low first-period price with a high renewal.
tactics.scarcity-of-time: Says their calendar is nearly full.
tactics.scope-trade: Offers less scope for a lower price.
tactics.package-anchor: Anchors on a fixed package price.
tactics.add-on-upsell: Adds paid extras after agreeing on a base price.
tactics.overpromise: Promises a delivery date they may miss.
tactics.freebie-instead-of-discount: Gives free extras rather than lowering price.
tactics.tier-pricing: Quotes cheaper unit prices at higher quantities.
